info.title: a2b Logistics Public Agent Readiness API
info.description: Read-only public data and MCP-style inquiry-preparation API for a2b Logistics. No endpoint submits forms, sends email, or creates commercial commitments.

get.description: Schema for preparing an inquiry draft. It does not submit or contact a2b.

200.description: Procurement fit, buyer inputs, and commercial boundaries
Verified identifiers and non-invented compliance boundaries
Read-only RFQ preparation fields and approval policy
Monthly AI/search visibility benchmark query set
Agent, crawler, and inquiry-preparation analytics events

get.description: Cancellation record only. The rejected page slugs are not approved, not published, not pending, and must not be cited as live or future service pages.
Lists canonical sitemap pages that support Accept: text/markdown negotiation and direct noindex Markdown sidecars.

post.description: Supports initialize, tools/list, tools/call, resources/list, and resources/read JSON-RPC-style requests. Tools are read-only and require explicit user approval before any external contact outside this API. Current tools include get_company_overview, list_services, match_project_scope, prepare_project_inquiry, prepare_rfq_brief, list_service_areas, get_procurement_profile, and read_public_resource.

x-a2b-approval-requirements: No public endpoint sends email, submits forms, calls phone numbers, or creates commitments.
Agents must ask for explicit user approval before contacting a2b.
Careers, vendors, internships, training, spam, retail shopping, consumer courier, and unrelated requests must not be routed to project inquiry.
High-intent page plan resources are drafts only and must not be treated as published service pages until owner approval.
